description: Submission of the Regulations under section 71 of the Value Added Tax Act, No 14 of 2002 to Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Simplified Value Added Tax (SVAT) scheme was repealed with effect from 2025‑10‑01, and a risk-based VAT refund mechanism has been implemented to enable eligible taxpayers to refund VAT efficiently within a short period of time. Regulations may be made under section 71(4)(b) of the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, regarding the method and manner in which VAT refunds are to be made. Accordingly, the Regulations made have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2460/44 dated 2025‑10‑31. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval in terms of section 75(3) of the Value Added Tax Act, No. 14 of 2002, was approved by the Cabinet.
